text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, Trainer. May we enjoy
another
year of—
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Ah! But this will not be like any other
year, will it?
This year, we'll run in the
Classics.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
We have but one primary goal to
achieve in the
year ahead. Say it,
Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: To win the Classic Triple Crown!

text_block_list.text:
Precisely. That's the podium from which I
will
preach my ideals.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
This will be a crucial year for us. I trust
that you
won't lag behind.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: That being said...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
We have a goal in sight, but no clear
plan to get
there.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Tell me, what resolution do you think we
should
set for ourselves?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list:
Wisdom. We should aim to make the right
choices.
Health. We should try to take care of ourselves.
Versatility. We should try to diversify our skills.

text_block_list.text:
Choosing wisely? I see. Certainly, we will
soon be
facing a great many choices.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
But do we not always strive to do the
right thing?
Why go to the trouble of
making that a
resolution?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: To keep us on the same page.

text_block_list.text:
There will inevitably be times when we
disagree
with one another.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But as long as we're both clear about our
goal of
making the optimal choices, we'll
always be able
to find common ground...
That's the idea, at least.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: I see. So that was your reasoning...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You wouldn't be trying to tell me
something,
would you?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Considering the way you worry for my
well-being,
this feels rather pointed.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I do not need to be reminded of the
importance
of a healthy lifestyle, but...
very well. I promise to
make an extra
effort this year.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: And I promise that you're in good hands.

text_block_list.text: Yours, you mean? Well, well.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
So you think the fundamentals aren't
enough, and
I must add more weapons
to my arsenal?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps you're right. It is time to learn
new
techniques in addition to refining
old ones.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
As luck would have it, there is one skill I
was
hoping to refine.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Why, comedy, of course! What else?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking it was time to expand
my
repertoire. I've been carrying around
a notepad
to write down jokes as they
come to me.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Two notepads, in fact. Would you care
to see
them?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Тренер? Why won't you look me in the
eye?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Very well. Whenever we clash, let us
strive to find
the best path forward.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
What are you doing? Why are you
backing away?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I look forward to seeing whether you can
live up
to that promise.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
We're walking around the academy after
deciding
on our resolution, when...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Well? Have you reconsidered your
decision?
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: I've thought about it, but...
text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager

text_block_list.text:
If it's a lack of results that concerns you,
I think
you're throwing in the towel too
quickly.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: I suggest that you—
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Ahem.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Ah! President!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
I had thought to wish you a happy New
Year, but
the mood does not seem to be
very festive.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If something is wrong, I would be happy
to lend a
hand.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: N-no, it's all right! Everything's fine!
text_block_list.name: Student Council General Manager

text_block_list.text:
Yes... It's fine. More importantly, this is
the year
in which you will face the trial
of achieving the
Classic Triple Crown.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
You're bound to be busier than ever.
Don't let us
distract you from your
training.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: But...
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I will explain everything in time. Until
then, I only
ask for your understanding.
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Very well. I'll see you at the New Year's
meeting.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text: Very good. Now, if you'll excuse me...
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text:
Эйр Грув and the student council
general
manager depart.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Are you sure you don't want to say something?

text_block_list.text:
I asked the general manager if
something was
bothering her earlier, but
she insisted that all was
well.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Whatever it is, she is confiding in Air
Groove
because she doesn't feel
comfortable sharing it
with me.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
It would only be insensitive to involve
myself.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for troubling you with student
council
affairs. I know that it's not in
your job description.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: If it's affecting you, it's important to me.

text_block_list.text: I appreciate your concern.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
However, I would rather you put this out
of your
mind. You have races to plan for.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Our first objective is the Satsuki Sho. I'm
counting
on you to lead us to victory,
Trainer.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
